runtimeHintSlots: Slots in use — checks running now divided by the total check slots across all workers (for example 0/64). One check occupies one slot until it finishes.
runtimeHintNoPermission: Pod names require platform administrator permission.
settingsDeliveryLogHint: Recent notification attempts. Payloads and integration URLs are never shown.
runtimeHintOverview: About API, workers and check slots
